title: Solutions Overview
meta_description: 24 outcome-based solutions: a named business problem, a composed architecture, a platform stack and a metric the program answers to.

blocks.x: Solutions are how clients buy outcomes rather than towers: a named business problem, a composed architecture from two to four towers, and a value case written in the CFO's units. Each one has run in delivery; none of them is slideware.

Every solution page carries the same contract: the problem in the client's words, the components that answer it, the platforms underneath, and what the value case is written against — priced against your baseline, never quoted from a brochure.
Start from the problem, not the technology. If the problem is not on the list, a briefing will map it — most client problems compose from the same two or three patterns.
The next step is small and real: one working session on the section map above, your data, and a written feasibility read you can circulate.
